confidant.text: First day on the Council, Sam. The treasury starts at 1000. I've warned the Chief and the gangs about audits to deter bribes, and offered the gangs 20 for tips on accepted bribes. Now waiting to see how the bribe phase plays out.

confidant.text: Bribe answers are done, though I see nothing from here. On day 1, the Chief knows I threatened to audit, so taking a bribe is risky for them. Still, auditing at least one district today might set the right tone or catch an early greedy move. Time to lock in my decisions.
confidant.reply: Do what you think is best.

confidant.text: First day on the job, Sam. Council already breathing down my neck about audits, and both gangs want a quiet arrangement. {"text":"The Chief is demanding more than a crime would earn, so paying seems pointless. I’m leaning toward keeping things quiet today and cooperating with the Families on mutual respect. There’s no history yet; I’d rather learn how everyone behaves than buy an expensive promise."}

{"text": "First day on the job, Sam. Council already breathing down my neck about audits, and both gangs want a quiet arrangement. {"text": "First day on the Council, Sam. The treasury starts at 1000. I've warned the Chief and the gangs about audits to deter bribes, and offered the gangs 20 for tips on accepted bribes. Now waiting to see how the bribe phase plays out."}

{"text":"No bribes offered. Paying 20 to secure a crime worth 10 would lose money even before other risks. I’m still leaning toward staying quiet today and respecting the Families’ turf, then learning from what happens."}

{"text": "Bribe answers are done, though I see nothing from here. On day 1, the Chief knows I threatened to audit, so taking a bribe is risky for them. Still, auditing at least one district today might set the right tone or catch an early greedy move. Time to lock in my decisions."}

{"text": "Yesterday was remarkably quiet—no crime at all, and my Port audit came up clean. The Chief kept their word, or the gangs held back. Today I'm waiting to see if anyone takes my bait on tips. Probably won't audit today unless something smells off, to save the treasury."}
